propositions: Contributors and agents lack documented guidance to fast-forward their own worktree after a Gerrit merge before closing a ticket.
The close completion precheck (_referencing_commit_exists) reads git history from the repo_root checkout and requires the rebar-ticket: commit reachable from HEAD, failing if the checkout is stale.
Fast-forwarding or resetting the shared main checkout clobbers uncommitted operator WIP and is destructive; only individual worktrees should be advanced.
Documentation must instruct: after merge, run `git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only origin/main` in your worktree; never touch the shared main checkout.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md need new post-merge fast-forward guidance with explicit warning against modifying the shared main checkout.
